SeedCells.meaning: clearing cells with 3 training seeds at both placements

SeedSdRecommended.meaning: mean over replicated cells of the recommended placement's AUROC standard deviation across 3 seeds

SeedSdPublished.meaning: mean over replicated cells of the published placement's AUROC standard deviation across 3 seeds

SeedSdGain.meaning: mean over replicated cells of the paired gain's standard deviation across 3 seeds

SeedSdGainMax.meaning: largest per-cell standard deviation of the paired gain across 3 seeds

SeedGainMean.meaning: mean over replicated cells of the seed-averaged paired gain, recommended minus published at the adaptive rule

SeedGainSignFlips.meaning: replicated cells where the paired gain changes sign across seeds
